GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 8th 6 Lengths 800m 10th rail 7 Lengths home turn 7th rails run Straight Kept Going Too Well # rails run/win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped with another runner on jumping, then raced keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 13l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well with limited room final 100m, # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and made contact with another rnr. Became unbalanced near the 200m after being bumped. Then was steadied after improving onto heels near the 50m and, as a result, when positioned behind that runner, was not tested to the finish.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn. Held Ground # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Crowded for room shortly after the start. Steadied near the 700m and again near the 650m. Q'd re the performance rider explained endured an interrupted run and was obliged to settle further back that desired and was disappointing in manner in which it finished off. Post-race vet no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length then kicked up and Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn 3 Lengths Two Wide , shifted out Straightening Up and ran up to hit Lead 220m, Headed narrowly at 140m, kept battling to the line # battled on well
jumped 2nd midfield 5len check 700m Straightening Up 5th made good ground late when taken to the outside # good for further
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped with another runner on jumping. Passing the 150m had to be directed out across the heels of another runner which shifted in, to continue into clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Straight Out The Back Settled Down Clear last 13 Lengths , only tacked on late, # Prefer To See Again
Jumped Ok trapped Wide early before working to settle outside leader. 2nd turn under pressure. weakened # worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Soon after straightening laid in before being corrected.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 5 lengths. moved up Wide turn 3 lengths. ran on strongly # Every Chance
Jumped Ok rolled forward to face breeze 1 length off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, found little and faded # weak run home
Jumped Ok drifted back to last 4-5l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off, kept on one pace # back/no threat
jumped out fine, soon Eased back Settled Down Inside 6th, about 8 Lengths @ 550m. couldn't quicken in Straight , weakened Clear last # never came into it
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: The gelding, which underwent a pre-race veterinary examination,  was cleared to race.
